inputs.name: RemoteArtifactCacheService.constructor.reads
inputs.description: An instance of HostedReadService supplies the authorized hosted-read and cache behavior used by artifact reads. Credential checks, authority changes, and offline-cache handling are delegated to it.

inputs.name: RemoteArtifactCacheService.pin.identity
inputs.description: A CacheIdentity records the principal, project, repository, and source/revision provenance used to associate a capture with a pinned evidence answer. pin stores a shallow copy keyed by JSON.stringify and evicts the oldest key after 64 identities; it does not validate the identity.

inputs.name: RemoteArtifactCacheService.read.input
inputs.description: The key is the generated artifact request path used with query.projectId to scope the cached entry. Query names one capture and supplies the expected SHA-256; its artifact hash must be 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters and the capture is limited to 11 MiB.

inputs.name: RemoteArtifactCacheService.read.load
inputs.description: The callback obtains a remote capture as bytes, media type, and authenticated principal when HostedReadService loads fresh data. The bytes must match query.sha256, fit within 11 MiB, use a supported media type, and carry the verified session principal.

outputs.name: RemoteArtifactCacheService.pin
outputs.description: Returns undefined after adding or refreshing the identity in the in-memory pinned map.

outputs.name: RemoteArtifactCacheService.read
outputs.description: Resolves to revalidated artifact bytes as a Uint8Array, the served media type, and SHA-256, from a fresh read or an accepted offline cache entry. The runtime byte array has no literal JSON sample. Captures larger than 11 MiB, hash mismatches, and unsupported media are rejected.

errors.name: Remote artifact data, integrity, or media failure
errors.description: The service throws Error for malformed or oversized cached data, a SHA-256 mismatch, unsupported media, and hosted authority or cache-identity failures. read can also reject with an error from load or HostedReadService if no validated offline cache entry can satisfy the request.
